sn12.66:1.2: Ekam samayam Bhagavā Kurusu viharati Kammāsadammam nāma Kurūnam nigamo || || 2
sn12.66:1.5: Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ || || 3
sn12.66:1.7: Sammasatha no tumhe bhikkhave antaraṃ sammasanti || || 4
sn12.66:1.8: Evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca || ||
sn12.66:1.9: Ahaṃ kho bhante sammasāmi antaraṃ sammasanti || || 5
sn12.66:1.10: Yathā katham pana tvam bhikkhu sammasasi antaram sammasanti || || 6
sn12.66:1.12: [Yathā so bhikkhu vyākāsi] na so bhikkhu Bhagavato cittam ārādhesi || || 7
sn12.66:2.1: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn12.66:2.2: Etassa Bhagavā kālo etassa Sugata kālo
sn12.66:2.3: yaṃ Bhagavā antaraṃ sammasaṃ bhāseyya || Bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantīti || || 8
sn12.66:2.4: Tena hānanda suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasi karotha bhāsissāmīti || ||
sn12.66:2.5: Evam bhanti ti kho te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ || || 9
sn12.66:3.1: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammasamāno sammasati antaraṃ sammasaṃ || ||
sn12.66:3.2: Yaṃ kho idam anekavidhaṃ nānappakārakaṃ dukkhaṃ loke uppajjati jarāmaraṇam ||
sn12.66:3.3: [idam kho dukkhanidānaṃ kiṃsamudayaṃ kiṃjātikam kimpabhavaṃ || kismiṃ sati jarāmaraṇaṃ hoti || kismiṃ asati jarāmaraṇaṃ na hotīti ||
sn12.66:3.5: Yaṃ kho idam anekavidhaṃ nānappakārakaṃ dukkhaṃ loke uppajjati jarāmaraṇaṃ ||]
sn12.66:3.6: idaṃ kho dukkham upadhinidānaṃ upadhisamudayaṃ upadhijātikaṃ upadhipabhavaṃ || upadhismiṃ sati jarāmaraṇaṃ hoti upadhismiṃ asati jarāmaraṇaṃ na hotīti ||
sn12.66:3.7: so jarāmaraṇaṃ ca pajānāti || jarāmaraṇasamudayām ca pajānāti || jarāmaraṇanirodhaṃ ca pajānāti || Yā ca jarāmaraṇanirodhasāruppagāminī paṭipadā tañ ca pajānāti || ||
sn12.66:3.9: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu sabbaso sammādukkhakkhayāya paṭipanno jarāmaraṇanirodhāya || || 10
sn12.66:4.2: upadhi panāyaṃ kiṃnidāno kiṃsamudayo kiṃjātiko kiṃpabhavo || kismiṃ sati upadhi hoti kismiṃ asati [upadhi] na hotīti || ||
sn12.66:4.4: Upadhi taṇhānidāno taṇhāsamudayo taṇhāpabhavo taṇhāya sati upadhi hoti taṇhāya asati upadhi na hotīti ||
sn12.66:4.5: so upadhiñca pajānāti upadhisamudayañca pajānāti upadhinirodhañca pajānati || yā ca upadhinirodhasāruppagāminī paṭipadā tañca pajānāti || ||
sn12.66:4.7: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu sabbaso sammādukkhakkhayāya paṭipanno upadhinirodhāya || || 11
sn12.66:5.2: Taṇhā panāyaṃ kattha uppajjamānā uppajjati kattha nivisamānā nivisatīti || ||
sn12.66:5.4: Yaṃ kho kiñci loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ etthesā taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati ettha nivisamānā nivisati ||
sn12.66:5.6: Cakkhuṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpam etthesā taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati ettha nivisamānā nivisati || ||
sn12.66:5.7: [Evaṃ peyyālo] || || 12 Sotaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarupam || pe|| || 13
sn12.66:5.11: Mano loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ etthesā taṇhā uppajjamāna uppajjati ettha nivisamānā nivisati || 17
sn12.66:6.1: Ye hi keci bhikkhave atītam addhānam samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpam taṃ niccato addakkhuṃ sukhato addakkhuṃ attato addakkhuṃ ārogyato addakkhuṃ khemato addakkhum
sn12.66:6.3: Ye taṇham vaḍḍhesuṃ te upadhiṃ vaḍḍhesuṃ ||
sn12.66:6.4: ye upadhiṃ vaḍḍhesuṃ te dukkhaṃ vaḍḍhesuṃ ||
sn12.66:6.5: ye dukkhaṃ vaḍḍhesuṃ te na parimucciṃsu jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi na parimucciṃsu
sn12.66:10.1: Ye pi hi keci bhikkhave anāgatam addhānaṃ samaṇā va brāhmaṇā vā yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ taṃ niccato dakkhinti || sukhato dakkhinti || attato dakkhinti || ārogyato dakkhinti || khemato dakkhinti ||
